newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish PBK sale decision in nearest future - min.
newsitem.headline: Polish PBK sale decision in nearest future - min.

text.p: Poland's Treasury Ministry will in the nearest future present to the cabinet documents about the privatisation of Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK), Treasury Minister Miroslaw Pietrewicz said on Thursday.
"I will present this case to the cabinet and the goverment will decide the further fate of this project," Pietrewicz told a news conference.
He did not give any details or a timetable and said that that PBK's privatisation was still in its negotiation stage.
Adam Kowalczyk, the head of the ministry's privatisation and restructuring department, also present, said the government could discuss PBK's sale when it meets next Tuesday.
The Polish government has for months delayed making a decision on the sell-off of PBK, worth between 1.2 billion zlotys and 1.6 billion zlotys.
There are currently two bidders for the bank -- a Polish consortium of banks and an insurance firm against South Korea's Samsung Group.
